identity.avatarNote: Your avatar shows your initials. Photo upload is coming later.
identity.name: Display name

pin.changeHint: Current PIN, then the new one twice
pin.forgotHint: Verify it's you, then choose a new PIN
pin.biometricHint: Unlock your PIN without typing it
pin.biometricConfirm: Enter your PIN to turn this on
pin.resetIntro: First enter your password to confirm it's you. This also lifts a lockout.
pin.resetChoose: You have 10 minutes to choose your new PIN.
pin.reauthExpired: That took longer than 10 minutes. Enter your password again.

notifications.notify_game_started_hint: When club members start a game

webPush.install: To get notifications on this iPhone, add the app to your home screen: tap Share, then "Add to Home Screen", and open Buraco from there.
webPush.prompt: Turn on notifications to hear about invites and rounds to confirm.
webPush.denied: Notifications are blocked. Turn them on in Settings → Notifications → Buraco.

devices.emptyBody: Allow notifications on this phone to receive invites and confirmations.

clubs.none: You're not in a club yet.
clubs.leaveBody: You'll stop seeing its games and stats. Your past games stay in the club history. You can rejoin with an invite code.
clubs.ownerCantLeaveBody: You own {{club}}. Transfer ownership to another member in Club settings first, then you can leave.

clubSettings.shareMessage: Join {{club}} on Buraco. Open {{link}} or enter the code {{code}} in the app.
clubSettings.rotateBody: The current code and QR stop working right away. Members who already joined stay in the club.
clubSettings.name: Club name
clubSettings.allowNegativeHint: Allow a team to score below zero in a round
clubSettings.seasonHint: YYYY-MM-DD. The leaderboard counts games from this date.
clubSettings.dateInvalid: Use a real date as YYYY-MM-DD.
clubSettings.snapshotNote: Changes apply to new games. Games already played keep the rules they started with.
clubSettings.readOnlyNote: Only the owner and admins can change these.
clubSettings.rolesNote: Admins can change the house rules, remove members and run tournaments. Only the owner can manage admins, make a new invite code or hand over the club.
clubSettings.trustGhost: Start now games count right away
clubSettings.trustGhostHint: Off: players confirm each game with their PIN before it counts in stats. Applies to new games.

members.transferBody: {{name}} will own the club and you'll become an admin. Only the new owner can undo this.
members.removeBody: {{name}} will lose access to the club. Their past games stay in the history.

accounts.addSubtitle: Give the player this username and password. They sign in once and stay signed in.
accounts.usernameHint: Letters a–z, numbers, dot, dash or underscore. 3 to 24 characters.
accounts.createdBody: {{name}} can now sign in. Share these details with them privately:
accounts.resetSubtitle: Their phones stay signed in. Give them the new password for their next sign-in.
accounts.username_chars: Use only a–z, 0–9, dot, dash or underscore, starting with a letter or number.

clubErrors.ownerOnly: Only the club owner can do this.
clubErrors.notAllowed: You're not allowed to do this.
clubErrors.memberGone: That player is no longer in the club.
clubErrors.nameInvalid: Club names must be 1 to 60 characters.

account.signOutBody: This phone stops getting invites and confirmations until you sign in again.
account.passwordBody: Your other signed-in phones stay signed in.

delete.title: Delete your account?
delete.subtitle: This can't be undone.
delete.profile: Your name, PIN and devices are removed.
delete.history: Past games stay for the other players, shown as "Former member".
delete.clubs: Clubs you own pass to the longest-standing admin, or member if there's none. A club with only you in it is deleted.
delete.games: Unfinished games you're in are abandoned.
